completeReps.title: Technique before load
completeReps.body: An incomplete rep (range of motion not reached) does not count. Better go down one step and do the full movement.

warmup.title: Warm up
warmup.body: One light set of 12 to 15 reps on the first exercise is enough to prepare muscles and joints. The app suggests it.

benchElbows.title: Bench press: elbows and shoulder blades
benchElbows.body: Elbows at about 45° from the body rather than flared, shoulder blades squeezed and down during the whole movement.

repsInReserve.title: Keep 1 to 2 reps in reserve
repsInReserve.body: End your sets feeling you could still do 1 or 2 reps, without going to failure every time.

progression.title: When to add weight
progression.body: When you reach the top of the rep range on all your sets, the load goes up one step at the next workout.

frequency.title: Twice a week, 10 to 20 sets
frequency.body: Training each muscle twice a week, with 10 to 20 sets per muscle per week, works well to build muscle.

machines.title: Machines or free weights
machines.body: Both build muscle equally: pick what you like and what is free at the gym.

protein.title: Protein
protein.body: Aim for about 1.6 g of protein per kg of body weight per day: beyond that, the extra gain is small.

collagen.title: Collagen
collagen.body: Collagen does not replace regular protein (meat, fish, eggs, dairy, legumes) to build muscle.

soreness.title: Soreness or pain?
soreness.body: Soreness is diffuse and goes away in 2 to 3 days. Sharp pain, joint pain or pain at rest is not normal: stop and ask for advice.

sleep.title: Rest is part of the program
sleep.body: Sleep and at least one full rest day a week help muscles recover and grow.

kneeCracking.title: Cracking knees
kneeCracking.body: Knees that crack without pain are common and usually harmless. If it hurts or swells, see a professional.

photo.title: One photo a month
photo.body: Same light, same angle, once a month: it tells more than the daily mirror.

etiquette.title: Gym etiquette
etiquette.body: Wipe the machine, put the weights back, and share the machine between sets if someone is waiting.

about.title: About
about.p1: This app was built entirely with the help of an artificial intelligence, and guided by me, Thibaut, a student developer trying to learn as best he can.
about.p2: I am neither a coach nor a health professional, and I am not perfect: there may be mistakes left. The app's advice relies on studies cited in the Credits, but it does not replace the advice of a coach, a doctor or a physiotherapist.
about.p3: I was not a fan of AI to begin with. But here it is for a good cause, and I find it works well.
about.p4: Any help is welcome: a mistake spotted, an idea, a tip, feel free to tell me.

about.reportSoon: The contact option is coming soon.
